job.question: What evaluation criteria and point values are used to score proposals in the Delaware Office of the State Treasurer's 2021 RFP for deferred compensation plan recordkeeping and administration services?
job.expected_facts: Total 100 points: (I) Vendor History and Depth of Public Defined Contribution Plan Experience - 10; (II) Scope of Vendor Operations and Ability to Meet Full Range of Requested Services - 20; (III) Plan Sponsor Experience: Website Access & Quality, Administrative and Compliance Support, Relationship Management, Performance Reporting and Industry/Trend Evaluation and Communication - 30; (IV) Participant Communication & Education: Custom Website, Voice Response System and Participant Call Center; Commitment to Customer Service/Issue Resolution; Custom Communication and Education Capabilities, Branding, Onsite Representatives and Guidance/Advice Tools - 30; (V) Overall Cost to Plans and Plan Participants - 10.
job.acceptance: Five categories with 10/20/30/30/10 points, correctly distinguishing plan-sponsor from participant services. Exhaustive examples within categories are optional.

reviews.reason: The document is Clark County, Washington’s 2026 RFP #955, not the Delaware Office of the State Treasurer’s 2021 RFP. Its two-tier scoring system does not support the requested five categories or their point values.
quotes: REQUEST for PROPOSAL # 955 PROFESSIONAL, TECHNICAL AND EXPERT SERVICES Clark County Washington RELEASE DATE: WEDNESDAY, MAY 6, 2026
This will be a Two-Tier scoring evaluation. A one hundred (100) point system will be used for each Tier (total of 200 points)
Tier 2: Finalist Presentations / Best and Final Offers
